linhas.en:
Rani's second SG.
A peculiar taste for leaving a certain area's skin exposed,
without equipping a Mystic Code for protection.
An SG one step higher would be of wanting to be exposed―――
commonly referred to as an exhibitionist. What a shame.

It is unknown why she came to have this SG.
The alchemist who made Rani apparently wore an
absurdly tight miniskirt, but no one's ever seen inside.
It's likely that such a sacred #RUBS      Zettai Ryouiki#RUBEAbsolute Territory#REND
had some influence on her thought structure.
There's also the theory that the slogan Rani utters:
"[#RUBS    pants hakase nai#RUBEOFF WITH THE PANTS#REND] is anagram to [#RUBS     hakase pants nai#RUBEPROFESSOR NO PANTS#REND]?"

             ◆

But while they have intelligence, humans are still animals.
No matter how advanced civilization becomes,
they will admire the wildlife running through the savanna.

Though Rani was made as an highly intelligent being,
she feels the fundamental beauty of "the natural form"
as a human, etched into her soul.
